name: Victory monument and Hill D1
nameVi: Tượng đài Chiến thắng Điện Biên Phủ — Đồi D1
summary: Walk the copper group on Hill D1 and the yard under it. Three soldiers and one Thái child hold a flag that reads “Quyết chiến, quyết thắng.” The yard is about 3,000 m². The group is also given as 217 tons. Those are a yard and a weight. Saturday evenings and holidays bring a cultural program. A start time is check on arrival. Skip noon, when the gates are shut.
fee: 20,000 VND for an adult at one point
getThere: A walk in the basin ward. Minutes are check on arrival.

body: Walk up to the copper group on Đồi D1, the eastern outpost of the Dominique group. The group is three soldiers and one Thái child. The flag reads “Quyết chiến, quyết thắng.” The sculptor is Nguyễn Hải. The ceremony yard under the group is about 3,000 m². The copper group is also given as 217 tons. A yard and a weight are not one measurement. From the hill you look over the city, the yellow rice, and the ridges. The hill is also kept as a peace park with that view.

Come in the morning, or on a Saturday evening or a holiday, when the yard holds a cultural program. A start and an end for that program were not given. Check on arrival. Day hours, all week including holidays, are 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–18:00 from 1 March to 30 September, and 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:30 from 1 October to 28 February. The gates are shut from 11:00 to 13:30. A visit length on the hill was not given. Check on arrival.

Adults 18 and over pay 20,000 VND a person a visit a point. Ethnic residents of the province, older people, and people with severe disability pay half. Veterans, people with a revolutionary-service paper, organized students and soldiers with a plan, people under 18, and people with especially severe disability are free. The monument is one of four points that issue an electronic receipt. The museum’s 100,000 VND visit, and the 5,000 VND figure for one of five sites at the museum, do not cover this hill.

gettingThere: Đồi D1 is in the center of the basin, in phường Điện Biên Phủ. Older wording still says thành phố Điện Biên Phủ. Walk from a hotel in the ward. Minutes on foot were not given. Check on arrival. A taxi fare inside the ward was not given either.

legs.heading: From the basin ward
legs.body: On foot, in the center. A published minute count from a central hotel is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: About 4 km, given as 10–15 minutes and as 8–10 minutes. Taxi fares on those lines are 70,000–80,000 VND and about 80,000 VND. Motorbike taxis are 50,000 VND and 40,000–60,000 VND. Those are not a city tariff.

hours: 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–18:00 from 1 March to 30 September. 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:30 from 1 October to 28 February. All week, including holidays. A Saturday-evening program has no published start or end. Check on arrival.
closed: Shut from 11:00 to 13:30 every day. No weekly close. Last entry, if it differs from closing, is check on arrival.
admissionNote: Adults 18 and over pay 20,000 VND a person a visit a point. Ethnic residents of the province, older people, and people with severe disability pay half. Veterans, people with a revolutionary-service paper, organized students and soldiers with a plan, people under 18, and people with especially severe disability are free. Whether the yard and the statue count as one point or two is check on arrival. The museum tickets are separate.
